source: Host, Lison, Moonen - A Systematic Approach to Predict the Impact of Cybersecurity Vulnerabilities Using LLMs (TRIAGE), arXiv:2508.18439, Table V and Table III (test split)
notes: Paper metrics: MAP = mean of per-CVE Average Precision; R@k = recall at top-k. Kaggle kernel nitaam/smet-run-b-c-rescore-on-triage uses different metrics (hit@k, micro/macro P/R/F1@k, parent-technique level, retrained BRON models) and is not directly comparable.
